original_card.question: Can a changed G20 helper path or independent-target split improve the complete BIT moment without losing its physical endpoint?
methods: Construct and independently check one source-bound instance of the stated first experiment.
Seek an exact counterexample or target-specific complete-budget obstruction to that same proposed change.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient. A scoped local result may be retained without a complete supplier. Expanding it into further construction rounds requires the family-level budget and obligation gate in research-family-status.md; an optimistic passing relaxation alone is not acceptance.

original_card.first_experiment: First read #5679/#5708 and their audits as pending component proposals. Choose one uncovered helper group/cut on an exact word; compare arbitrary-input native action, targets, owned storage, both orientations and full signed bill. Stop if the gain is only a scalar count or repaid by lost targets. Do not rerun the frozen #5609 common-frame domain without changing its hypothesis.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Judge the actual current supplier contract and complete signed target/paid bill; frozen-profile ceilings require an applicability proof.
allowed_variations: One exact source head, helper/cut region or quantified proposition and changed hypothesis; check live handoffs first. Different seeds are not different scopes.

Treating an archived proposal or local numerical pass as complete supplier admission.

actual_scope: On the emitted PR5708 word, move exactly one correction of each A2 conjugation of length at least 5 onto a different frame of the published one-edge route table, and decide whether the paid-query moment falls on (0,1).
scope_change_reason: The card says to review the #5679/#5708 chain and stop when a proposed cut does not improve the paid moment. #6305 certified length 4 and above at the contact frame, #6337 certified one moved correction for lengths 1..3, and #6633 certified one moved correction at length 4. This package takes the remaining length-at-least-5 one-move clause on the same word and route table.
bottleneck_link: A paid-moment obstruction on this exact word says the length-at-least-5 one-move conjugation domain does not raise the ordinary BIT component. It does not change the selected exponent.
stop_rule: Stop when every one-move frame on the 1,384 intervals of length at least 5 is classified. Do not open a two-move search in this package.

open_questions.question: Can two corrections in one length-at-least-5 interval lower the paid moment when both frames move?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This certificate moves exactly one correction. PR #6664 already shows that two moves fail to emit at lengths 2..4, and leaves length at least 5 open.
open_questions.first_step: Enumerate one length-5 interval's two-move pairs on this word and one-edge route table, with every other correction left on its contact frame.
open_questions.blocked_by: No favorable witness is supplied. The eight one-move emissions are strict losses, and the one-move census does not produce a saving seed.

open_questions.question: Does one added route at the first missing edge of a dirty failure turn that word into a strict saving?
open_questions.why_it_matters: 686,779 moved frames fail on a dirty wire's next route. A different route table could pass that edge and then has to be priced again.
open_questions.first_step: Group those failures by the missing frame pair and test one added edge against the eight known loss shapes.
open_questions.blocked_by: The published PATHS.json is the route table. Adding an edge changes the hypothesis this package holds fixed.
